reason: The Trainee Laptop Shield and Google Drive isolation are strong features, but having avoided cloud platforms for years over confidentiality fears, I will not pay for an annual subscription until I independently audit the restricted OAuth permissions on the free tier.
objection: Granting any third-party app OAuth access to our firm's Google Drive creates an unacceptable risk of client data exposure or accidental corruption, and training rotating trainees still sounds burdensome.
would_change_my_mind: Verifying the restricted drive.file scope on the free sandbox with zero data leakage and having my trainee handle ROC filing annexures with zero handholding.
